{{Quote|The Cobral family is the largest power on Frego. They are in charge of a crime ring that has successfully controlled the government for twenty years.|Jocasta Nu|<ref name="JA:TOW" />}}
'''The Cobral''' was the criminal organization that controlled the planet [[Frego]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The Cobral was a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Black marketeer|dealers]] founded by the [[Cobral family]] who eventually took over the planetary government of the planet [[Frego]],<ref name="CDAG" /> in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The Cobrals lost control over Frego when one of the children of the family, [[Solan Cobral]], killed his brother [[Rutin Cobral|Rutin]] to ensure his place as head of the family.<ref name="JA:TOW" />

After the Cobrals leaders were imprisoned, some of its members relocated to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] which became their base of operations and established the [[Neo-Cobral]].<ref name="CDAG" />
